newsitem.title: USA: Deluxe Q1 revenues cut by divestitures.
newsitem.headline: Deluxe Q1 revenues cut by divestitures.

text.p: Deluxe Corp said Monday the drop in its first quarter revenues reflected the divestiture of six businesses during 1996.
Earlier, Deluxe reported first quarter sales of $466.5 million, down from $488.1 million a year ago. Its net earnings were $0.50 a share, up from $0.23 a year ago after a $0.25 charge.

"Although our full-year earnings target is weighted toward the end of the year, reflecting our continuing cost reduction efforts and our new revenue programs, this quarter's results represent a solid first step for us toward that goal," J.A. Blanchard, Deluxe chairman, said in a statement.
